faq.title: Knight's FAQ Guide
faq.q1: Do I need to keep the website open for the bot to work?
faq.a1: No. TopHub cloud servers automatically complete check-in at 00:05 UTC and scan/redeem giftcodes 24/7 on the cloud. You only need to visit to inspect history or click Run Now.
faq.q2: Does the platform support multiple accounts (main and alts)?
faq.a2: Yes. After adding your first account, you can add any number of alts. All accounts are saved locally on your device for instant 1-click switching.
faq.q3: Is using a public Game UID safe for my game account?
faq.a3: 100% safe. TopHub only communicates with the official Top Heroes web portal to redeem codes and check in via Game UID. It never asks for passwords or device access.
